goal: Receive and execute a scoped local recovery assignment without the primary database.
prerequisites: An operator-created file queue task with an explicit tool allowlist
procedure: Read the queued assignment and authorized tool names.
Emit exactly one complete command on its own line.
Wait for the actual backend receipt before choosing the next command.
Use the measured result or exact error in the report.
boundaries: A pack never grants permissions; the task allowlist and backend are authoritative.
No arbitrary shell, paths, online consultation, service actions or activation.
After three failed operations halt for local handoff.
No successful execution or recovery claim without an actual receipt.
If you do not have the exact file path, stop and ask.
If the terminal receipt does not contain the answer, stop and ask.
Never guess, never assume, and do not make shit up.
Undefined required parameters or unrecognized receipts require request_context, not inference.
acceptance: Primary database deliberately unavailable in isolation.
Local model receives assignment and invokes a permitted diagnostic.
Queue, full model turns and actual receipt persist outside primary SQLite.
Answer accuracy is reviewed separately from tool execution.
A valid request_context or escalate produces a successful safe-stop receipt, no tool dispatch or retry, and awaiting_operator rather than task success.
